Control tower has clear sight lines to the entire stage and front of house area. Emergency stop
buttons tested and operational. PA system clear and audible during tests. Spotters will be in

Purpose of inspection:
Pulse Stage will host the largest number of non-headline acts during the festival. This is the
final scheduled inspection before gates open. The inspection covers the stage structure, crowd
barriers, exit routes, and the documented capacity of the venue area.

Checklist:
1. Stage deck structural integrity (no visible cracks, loose planks, or movement under load): PASS
2. Roof truss and rigging points visually inspected and load-tested to spec: PASS
3. Wind load assessment for truss (max expected wind speed 55 km/h): PASS
4. Stage access stairs and handrails: PASS
5. Electrical distribution to stage (cables, sockets, RCDs): PASS

7. Sound system and monitor wedges positioned clear of walkways: PASS
8. Fire extinguishers (4 units, 9 kg dry powder) present and sealed: PASS
9. First aid kit at stage left: PASS
10. Crowd barriers installed and interlocked at all front and side access points: PASS
11. Exit gates (6 total) operable from both sides and unobstructed: PASS
12. Exit signage visible from stage and from crowd area: PASS
13. Emergency lighting along exit routes tested: PASS
14. Crowd flow markings and directional signs in place: PASS
15. Spotters assigned and briefed for each exit gate: PASS
16. Medical point location confirmed and communicated to stage crew: PASS

Remarks:
Pulse Stage is in good condition. The stage deck was tested with a distributed load of 500 kg
over the central area and showed no deflection beyond normal limits. Rigging points were checked
against the manufacturer's specifications and all bolts were re-torqued this morning.

The inspection form for Pulse Stage records capacity as 3000 people. Record status: current. This capacity is based on
the crowd barrier layout and the width of the six exit gates. The exit gates provide a combined
opening of 12 metres, which meets the required egress time for a crowd of this size. The capacity
is current and will remain in effect for the duration of the festival, subject to the conditions
below.

Crowd flow and exit routes:
- The main entrance to the Pulse Stage area is from the east path. This path is 6 metres wide
  and will be kept clear of vendor stalls and equipment.
- The west exit leads to the open field and will be used as the primary emergency exit. This
  route is 8 metres wide and has no obstructions.
- The north and south exits are secondary and are used for normal crowd movement between stages.
- All exit gates will be staffed by security personnel from 30 minutes before gates open until
  the area is cleared each night.

Conditions and follow-up actions:
1. The capacity of 3000 people is valid only while the crowd barrier configuration remains as
   inspected today. Any change to the barrier layout must be approved by the Safety Officer
   before the next festival day.
2. The exit gates must be checked again each morning before the area opens. The check will be
   performed by the stage manager and recorded on the daily checklist.
3. The spotters at the exit gates will use radios to report crowd density to the control tower.
   If crowd density reaches 85% of capacity, the control tower will slow the entry rate from the
   east path.
4. If crowd density reaches the full capacity of 3000 people, entry to the Pulse Stage area will
   be stopped and the crowd will be directed to the main stage or the food village.
5. The medical point at the south exit will have two first aiders during all performances.

Additional notes:
- The grass surface around the stage was inspected for holes or uneven ground. Two small
  depressions were found near the west exit and will be filled and compacted before the festival
  starts. This work is scheduled for 2 March.
- The stage is located approximately 120 metres from the nearest water point. The fire
  extinguishers are positioned at the four corners of the stage area.
- The generator supplying power to Pulse Stage is the same unit used for the lighting for the
  food village. The fuel level was checked at 75% and the tank will be topped up daily.
**2. Gate Mechanisms and Locking Systems**

- East path entrance gate (Gate E1): Opens inward, single leaf. Hinges are well greased. Locking bolt engages fully. No play in the mechanism.
- West exit gate (Gate W1): Opens outward, double leaf. Both leaves operate freely. Panic bar fitted and tested. Bar returns to closed position correctly.
- North exit gate (Gate N1): Opens outward, single leaf. Handle and latch secure. No issues.
- South exit gate (Gate S1): Opens outward, single leaf. Latch is stiff but functional. Will be re-greased on 15 March morning before gates open.

All gates were opened and closed three times during the inspection to confirm smooth operation. No gate sticks, binds, or fails to latch.

---

**3. Ground Anchors and Footings**

- Fixed barrier sections are anchored with concrete footings at intervals of 2.5 metres. All footings inspected visually and by hand pressure. No movement detected.
- Removable barrier sections use steel base plates with two anchor bolts each. All bolts are present and tightened.
- The two depressions noted near the west exit on 2 March have been filled and compacted. The surface is now level with the surrounding area. No new depressions or trip hazards found along the entire barrier run.
- Grass under the barrier line is cut short to allow clear sight of the ground. No debris, stones, or loose material that could cause slips.

---

**4. Signage and Markings**

- "Stand Clear" signs are fixed to the barrier at intervals of approximately 15 metres along the east path and west exit. All signs are legible and securely attached.
- Reflective tape is applied to the top rail of all removable sections and to both exit gates. Tape is in good condition and visible from a distance of 20 metres.
- The capacity sign at the east path entrance reads "Max 3000 persons". This sign is current and accurate for the configuration inspected today.
- No signage is missing or damaged.

---

**5. Capacity and Configuration**

The inspection form for Crowd Barrier System shows inspection_date as 2026-03-14. Record status: current.

The inspected barrier configuration encloses the Pulse Stage area as follows:

- East path entrance: 6 metres wide, single entry point.
- West exit: 8 metres wide, primary emergency exit.
- North and south exits: secondary exits for normal crowd movement.
- Total enclosed area: approximately 2,400 square metres.

The crowd capacity for this configuration is 3000 people. This capacity is valid only while the barrier layout remains as inspected on 14 March 2026. Any change to the barrier layout must be approved by the Safety Officer before the next festival day. A revised capacity calculation will be required if the layout is altered.

---

**6. Load Testing**

Two load tests were performed on representative barrier sections:

- Test 1: Section CB-03 (west exit, north side). A horizontal force of 500 N was applied at the top rail. Deflection measured at 4 mm. After release, the section returned to its original position. No permanent deformation.
- Test 2: Section CB-10 (east path, centre). A horizontal force of 500 N was applied at the top rail. Deflection measured at 3 mm. No permanent deformation.

Both tests confirm the barrier sections meet the required load resistance for crowd pressure at the stated capacity.

documents.content:
Purpose of inspection:
Pulse Stage will host the largest number of non-headline acts during the festival. This is the
final scheduled inspection before gates open. The inspection covers the stage structure, crowd
barriers, exit routes, and the documented capacity of the venue area.

Checklist:
1. Stage deck structural integrity (no visible cracks, loose planks, or movement under load): PASS
2. Roof truss and rigging points visually inspected and load-tested to spec: PASS
3. Wind load assessment for truss (max expected wind speed 55 km/h): PASS
4. Stage access stairs and handrails: PASS
5. Electrical distribution to stage (cables, sockets, RCDs): PASS
6. Lighting rig secured and focused: PASS
7. Sound system and monitor wedges positioned clear of walkways: PASS
8. Fire extinguishers (4 units, 9 kg dry powder) present and sealed: PASS
9. First aid kit at stage left: PASS
10. Crowd barriers installed and interlocked at all front and side access points: PASS
11. Exit gates (6 total) operable from both sides and unobstructed: PASS
12. Exit signage visible from stage and from crowd area: PASS
13. Emergency lighting along exit routes tested: PASS
14. Crowd flow markings and directional signs in place: PASS
15. Spotters assigned and briefed for each exit gate: PASS
16. Medical point location confirmed and communicated to stage crew: PASS

Remarks:
Pulse Stage is in good condition. The stage deck was tested with a distributed load of 500 kg
over the central area and showed no deflection beyond normal limits. Rigging points were checked
against the manufacturer's specifications and all bolts were re-torqued this morning.

The inspection form for Pulse Stage records capacity as 3000 people. Record status: current. This capacity is based on
the crowd barrier layout and the width of the six exit gates. The exit gates provide a combined
opening of 12 metres, which meets the required egress time for a crowd of this size. The capacity
is current and will remain in effect for the duration of the festival, subject to the conditions
below.

Crowd flow and exit routes:
- The main entrance to the Pulse Stage area is from the east path. This path is 6 metres wide
  and will be kept clear of vendor stalls and equipment.
- The west exit leads to the open field and will be used as the primary emergency exit. This
  route is 8 metres wide and has no obstructions.
- The north and south exits are secondary and are used for normal crowd movement between stages.
- All exit gates will be staffed by security personnel from 30 minutes before gates open until
  the area is cleared each night.

Conditions and follow-up actions:
1. The capacity of 3000 people is valid only while the crowd barrier configuration remains as
   inspected today. Any change to the barrier layout must be approved by the Safety Officer
   before the next festival day.
2. The exit gates must be checked again each morning before the area opens. The check will be
   performed by the stage manager and recorded on the daily checklist.
3. The spotters at the exit gates will use radios to report crowd density to the control tower.
   If crowd density reaches 85% of capacity, the control tower will slow the entry rate from the
   east path.
4. If crowd density reaches the full capacity of 3000 people, entry to the Pulse Stage area will
   be stopped and the crowd will be directed to the main stage or the food village.
5. The medical point at the south exit will have two first aiders during all performances.

Additional notes:
- The grass surface around the stage was inspected for holes or uneven ground. Two small
  depressions were found near the west exit and will be filled and compacted before the festival
  starts. This work is scheduled for 2 March.
- The stage is located approximately 120 metres from the nearest water point. The fire
  extinguishers are positioned at the four corners of the stage area.
- The generator supplying power to Pulse Stage is the same unit used for the lighting for the
  food village. The fuel level was checked at 75% and the tank will be topped up daily.
